subject: Anthropic Compliance API local session transcripts beta for Claude Code and Cowork, announced 2026-08-11
central_claim: Anthropic's Compliance API local session transcript beta is a publishable AI engineering topic because it moves locally run Claude Code and Cowork agent sessions into a central audit API: official release notes and docs support a bounded E2 claim about endpoint coverage, transcript shape, retention and exclusions, while the article avoids claiming complete endpoint monitoring or independent security effectiveness.

selection.reason: The topic affects concrete enterprise decisions about local coding agents, compliance export, SIEM/DLP integration, retention and the boundary between API transcripts, OpenTelemetry telemetry and inline inference hooks. It is not a same-day model release, so novelty is 1, but it was not selected previously and clears the threshold with multiple official primary URLs.

Opened Claude Code monitoring docs to compare OpenTelemetry telemetry with Compliance API transcript retrieval. Used only for role separation, not for the core release fact.

Opened OpenAI's August 17 security essay surface through official news search. It is timely, but it is a strategic/security position article rather than a concrete new model/API/runtime release with an E2 implementation surface.

DeepSeek V4 Pro GA, DeepSeek Harness and V4-Pro-0813 technical angle were already covered in recent regular/special AI editions. The source path remained part of discovery but was not selected again.

Opened or reviewed official Mistral changelog and vLLM release surfaces in the broader run. No newer unhandled candidate outranked the selected Anthropic compliance/runtime topic for concrete engineering decision utility.

claims.claim: Anthropic announced on 2026-08-11 that the Compliance API now returns transcripts of Cowork and Claude Code sessions that run on users' machines, in beta for Claude Enterprise organizations.
The local session transcript surface provides list, retrieve and messages endpoints under /v1/compliance/apps/sessions/local and uses a Compliance Access Key with read:compliance_user_data scope.

Local endpoint coverage includes Cowork in Claude Desktop and Claude Code in terminal, Claude Desktop or IDE extension when running on a user's machine, while several surfaces and data-retention modes are excluded.

Transcript messages are reconstructed from captured Claude API calls and include user prompts, assistant responses, tool calls and text tool results, but omit thinking blocks, system prompt content, tool definitions, MCP server configuration and most binary or structured content.

Local session export jobs need trailing-window re-listing and deduplication because local sessions have no status or updated_at, created_at can move as retention elapses, cursors expire after a walk window, and newly captured messages can appear after a processing delay.
Compliance API transcript retrieval, OpenTelemetry logging and inference hooks serve different roles: after-the-fact record retrieval, telemetry streaming and inline allow/deny control respectively.
